software.text: Tell me about yourself and why you are interested in this role.
Describe a challenging technical problem you solved. What was your approach?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
Walk me through a project you are proud of and your specific contribution.
How do you approach debugging code that fails only in production?
Where do you see yourself growing technically over the next two years?

data.text: Tell me about yourself and your interest in data science.
Describe a dataset you cleaned. What problems did you find?
Explain a model you built and how you validated it.
Tell me about a time your analysis changed a decision.

follow_ups: You mentioned the outcome briefly - what was the measurable result?
What was YOUR specific contribution there, as opposed to the team's?
What would you do differently if you faced that situation again?
Can you walk me through the concrete steps you took, in order?
What was the hardest trade-off you had to make in that decision?
